items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I remember a Thanksgiving turkey supper I took her out to because her mother made wonderful organic food

ctx.x: You’re very into dynamics and setting up expectations and sometimes giving us what we might expect and then sometimes not. I especially like the part where it sort of eased into that nice waltz.

Yes. I saw her waltzing almost on ice in Central Park and of course as the memories go on I sense I’m there watching her for ten minutes and of course this is exaggeration but I remember a Thanksgiving turkey supper I took her out to because her mother made wonderful organic food, but I don’t think meat was encouraged. Monk, it’s so great to be with you. I’ve loved your show for years.
There’s a great deal to learn from you and I think — I don’t have people talking about some of these things, so this has been very valuable for me.
